Set up email notifications

Configure a connection to an outgoing mail server so that Jira can send email notifications. You can configure a mail server now or after you have set up Jira.

Configure Email Notifications
The name of this server within Jira.
The default address this server will use to send emails from (be sure that this email address is allowed to send mail through the server specified).
A prefix which is prepended to every subject (useful in helping users filter mail).
Server Type
To send email notifications via an SMTP server, enter the host name of the SMTP server.
The mail protocol to use.
Optional - SMTP port number to use. Leave blank for default (default: 25).
Timeout for every request sent from Jira to mail server. Leave the default or enter 0 for no timeout.
Optional - the mail server requires the use of TLS security.
Optional - if you use authenticated SMTP to send email, enter your username.
Optional - as above, enter your password if you use authenticated SMTP.
To send email notifications via an existing mail session, enter the JNDI location of the javax.mail.Session object.
